Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bank of India (BOI) has recently published the notification for the recruitment of Apprentice Posts on the official website of BOI. This recruitment has been issued for 400 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official All India Exam Result2026, Online applying process for Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 has Started from 25 December 2025 & the candidates can apply till the 10 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 23 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 25 December 2025
  • Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 800/-
  • SC, ST, All Female : Rs. 600/-
  • PH : Rs. 400/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
